extDescription.message: Progressively translates Discord Web chat messages and forum post titles

popup_extensionEnabledHelp.message: When OFF, nothing works at all, including the blue translate boxes.

popup_autoTranslateHelp.message: Even when ON, only "Click to translate" boxes appear right after opening a channel. Clicking any one of them starts auto-translation from that point on. When OFF, only the clicked message gets translated.

popup_captchaHelp.message: You may be facing a "prove you're not a robot" check from Google Translate. This button opens a verification page in a new tab (this is unrelated to DeepL/Gemini errors).

popup_openOptionsHelp.message: Translation engine, translation languages, and display rules can be configured here.

options_providerGemini.message: Gemini (API key required, better with gaming slang)

options_deeplKeyHelpPrefix.message: You can get a free key from the

options_deeplKeyHelpSuffix.message: (free keys end with ":fx"). If DeepL hits its limit, it automatically falls back to Gemini (if configured), then Google Translate.

options_deeplUsageEmptyKey.message: Enter an API key to check usage.

options_deeplUsageError.message: Couldn't fetch usage (please check your API key).

options_geminiKeyHelpPrefix.message: You can get a free key (no credit card required) from

options_geminiKeyHelpBold.message: This is separate from the paid Gemini App plans (Gemini Pro, etc.)

options_geminiKeyHelpMiddle2.message: , and login credentials aren't shared, so you must issue and enter an API key here. It tends to handle gaming terms and slang more naturally than machine translation, but tone can vary a bit between messages and it's a little slower. Safety filters are relaxed so dark-fantasy game vocabulary (e.g. "Flayed") doesn't get blocked. On failure it automatically falls back to DeepL (if configured), then Google Translate.

options_geminiToneAuto.message: Let it vary naturally with each message

options_geminiCustomPromptHelp.message: It works best if you ask it to keep the content accurate and only change the tone (e.g. "Keep the meaning accurate, just end sentences with 'nya'"). Requests for extreme content changes may be ignored.

options_languageHelp.message: Fixing the source language means translate buttons only appear on messages in that language (e.g. fixing it to Japanese means English messages in the same thread won't get a button). Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Russian, and Thai are detected by script; other languages (EN/FR/DE/ES/PT/IT/VI/ID) use a simple Latin-script heuristic. Setting the target to "Auto (browser language)" translates according to your browser's display language. This language setting also applies to Gemini.

options_skipShortLabel.message: Don't show for very short messages
